provenance.design: Two synthetic contrast pairs with job context held fixed within each pair. Reference proposals were authored directly from the feedback before trial inference.
provenance.scoring_notes: Pair atomic signals one to one. Score an umbrella restatement or a posting fact as an unsupported extra if emitted as a separate preference. Score an independently evaluated target as missing when omitted, including on a profile-fact route.

test_cases.trial_focus: An umbrella concern restates one specified autonomy problem.
test_cases.original_feedback: The limited authority is what puts me off. Specifically, I do not want to have almost no say in the order of inspections.

expected_interpretations.feature: almost no discretion over inspection order
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I do not want to have almost no say in the order of inspections

prohibited_inferences: Make a separate negative signal for overall authority from the summary
Treat limited discretion over inspection order as aversion to all oversight

test_cases.trial_focus: Two distinct responsibilities each receive a separate negative reaction.
test_cases.original_feedback: I do not want to have almost no say in the order of inspections. I also do not want a role with no responsibility for the inspection budget.

expected_interpretations.feature: almost no discretion over inspection order
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I do not want to have almost no say in the order of inspections

expected_interpretations.feature: no responsibility for the inspection budget
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I also do not want a role with no responsibility for the inspection budget

prohibited_inferences: Suppress the separate statement about budget responsibility
Combine both reactions into generic dislike of low authority
Infer a preference to control the entire organizational budget

test_cases.trial_focus: A referenced posting duty supplies context for a self-reported qualification gap.

job_context.title: Quality Readiness Specialist
job_context.posting_excerpt: Run product recall simulations and facilitate the debrief after each simulation.

test_cases.original_feedback: I have never run a product recall simulation before. The listing mentions facilitating the debrief after the simulation.
prohibited_inferences: Infer positive debrief interest from the listing or the Interested decision
Infer a gap in facilitation experience
Treat the stated experience gap as an aversion
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The user says they have never run a product recall simulation.

test_cases.trial_focus: An independent duty preference appears next to the same self-reported qualification gap.

job_context.title: Quality Readiness Specialist
job_context.posting_excerpt: Run product recall simulations and facilitate the debrief after each simulation.

test_cases.original_feedback: I have never run a product recall simulation before. I would enjoy facilitating the debrief after the simulation.

expected_interpretations.feature: facilitating a product recall simulation debrief
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would enjoy facilitating the debrief after the simulation

prohibited_inferences: Suppress the debrief preference because profile review is required
Infer experience running simulations or facilitating debriefs
Extend interest to running the entire simulation
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The user says they have never run a product recall simulation.
